sub_sector.value: baby and children's apparel; baby gear and accessories

product_category.detail: Baby, toddler and kids clothing; also Skip Hop baby gear and lunch boxes and bags.

market_position.detail: Widely available national baby and children's brand at moderate prices, sold through own stores and major retailers.

distribution_model.detail: Sells through own carters.com and brand sites, company stores, and wholesale partners; also a Carter's credit card program.

purchase_frequency.detail: Parents repeatedly buy children's clothing as kids grow and seasons change.

notes: Distribution and market position partly rely on general knowledge of the company's stores and wholesale partners.
